# How to Build a Software Factory

Workshop repository for ODSC AI West 2026. Follow along on the [workshop page](https://odsc-eventdesk-workshop.vercel.app).

## Set up

You need Git, Node.js 24+, pnpm 12.4.2, and Codex or Claude Code.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Thytu/odsc-ai-west-2026-software-factory-training eventdesk
cd eventdesk
pnpm install
pnpm run setup
pnpm dev
```
